profile.bio: I'm a full stack developer with over 7 years of experience turning ideas into polished products. I specialize in React, Node.js, and cloud-native architecture, with a track record of shipping features that users love and code that teams can maintain. What sets me apart is a designer's eye paired with engineering rigor — I care about both how a product looks and how it performs under load.
